carrier_yelingyun_s1_sword_idle_v6.scaleRationale: The old iron sword, sheath and relaxed left-hand reach are visible pose overhang; the common head-to-sole body ruler remains identical to the other S1 methods.

carrier_yelingyun_s1_spell_idle_v6.scaleRationale: The folded paper and low talisman pouch stay inside the novice's natural silhouette and do not create a wider or taller body profile.

carrier_yelingyun_s1_body_idle_v6.scaleRationale: Raised forearms and the wider planted stance are method and pose overhang. They must not bulk the same lean S1 body into a separate anatomy.

carrier_yelingyun_s1_pill_idle_v6.scaleRationale: The closed copper box and single medicine pouch are low method cues; their small overhang cannot alter the novice's canonical body scale.

carrier_corridor_seal_spirit_idle_l1.scaleRationale: one narrow suspended seal core, asymmetric paper wings and visible empty air below; never a legged shrine or robed humanoid

7bcd5173aeedc19ca03d910cfc600e40959163ab.rationale: The old iron sword, sheath and relaxed left-hand reach are visible pose overhang; the common head-to-sole body ruler remains identical to the other S1 methods.

10c746d8a87934bfda71f968d56b0d2601d20b45.rationale: The training dummy is deliberately a little taller and more rigid than the novice; its sword reach is excluded from anatomical width.

3863440e99c3624914bcf9b9ead706665ffaed65.rationale: The construct earns threat through independently authored breadth, low mass and forearm volume rather than a uniformly enlarged human.

3551e36059ecd484b3096c707c7c7891613c47a9.rationale: The folded paper and low talisman pouch stay inside the novice's natural silhouette and do not create a wider or taller body profile.

33cfcdfd8c4650158aaabbcd900782b34e75e8da.rationale: Raised forearms and the wider planted stance are method and pose overhang. They must not bulk the same lean S1 body into a separate anatomy.

3e6bf68e786fd9e703eb655e643c4c63b23b01a6.rationale: The closed copper box and single medicine pouch are low method cues; their small overhang cannot alter the novice's canonical body scale.

af0354b83be2c2060cef4dfe6339ad37f35a0e4f.rationale: one narrow suspended seal core, asymmetric paper wings and visible empty air below; never a legged shrine or robed humanoid

98cf11c2a7fb530d26f3824f54cc8f219967a574.rationale: The 24-year-old sword cultivator gains modest height and a steadier adult stance; the old iron sword remains pose overhang, never body width. No muscle inflation, rags, armour or uniform scale multiplier.
